review_type: Independent AI review of receipt-persistence correction only
scope: Exact helper diff and four focused receipt-persistence regression tests; no source-piece, gold, old source-QC or statistical re-audit.

findings.finding: SSD receipt uses exclusive creation and is fully written, flushed and fsynced before the optional internal mirror.
Only internal ENOSPC is suppressed; the SSD receipt remains complete. Other internal IO errors propagate after SSD evidence is preserved.
Both entry gates now refuse an existing SSD receipt. Exclusive receipt creation also preserves existing SSD or internal content.

Receipt status construction, verified state, and both post-receipt failure raises are unchanged. A false return describes mirror failure only and cannot turn a failed acquisition into a verified success.
Internal ENOSPC can leave an absent, empty or partial internal mirror; use the complete SSD JSON as authoritative. An internal file alone is not success evidence.
SSD write or fsync errors remain fatal and may leave an incomplete exclusive file; this correction does not claim persistence under SSD failure.
The correction does not retroactively recover terminal receipt evidence for session 44131. Its terminal failure and preserved checkpoint remain the reported existing state.

future_execution_requirement: Any future acquisition requires a concrete exact-plan focused admission binding the new script hash. Historical old-hash plans and reviews remain historical.
